features.name: Python scraper scripts
features.note: Zero-dependency SEC EDGAR scraper using Python stdlib (urllib). Fixed CIK URL bug (company CIK, not insider CIK). Added IGNORECASE regex for camelCase XML tags. Handles both non-derivative and derivative transactions. Successfully scraped 60 real trades across all 20 tickers.

features.name: Real SEC EDGAR data
features.note: 60 real SEC EDGAR Form 4 trades (23 buys, 37 sells) merged with existing mock data. 67 total entries. Data from May 2026 filings: Amy Coleman (MSFT), Mark Stevens (NVDA), Philipp Schindler (GOOGL), Matthew Garman (AMZN), etc.

features.name: Finviz-style screener page with filters + summary/trades modes
features.note: Lazy-loaded route /screener. DIR filter (ALL/BUY/SELL), ticker dropdown, SUMMARY/TRADES view toggle, sortable columns (9 in summary, 8 in trades). Computed signal score per ticker. TERM/SCRN nav toggle in header. Bloomberg dark theme, 10.85KB chunk.

features.name: Heatmap/treemap view
features.note: HeatmapPage: colored tile grid with SIGNAL/NET_FLOW/VOLUME modes, adjustable tile size (40-120px), hover tooltips. TreemapPage: SVG treemap with INSIDER_NET/BUY_RATIO/TOTAL_VALUE modes, tile size proportional to trade volume. Both lazy-loaded routes. Nav buttons (HTMP/TRMP) on all page headers. Chunky sizes: 7.94KB heatmap, 7.54KB treemap.

features.name: Stock detail page with charts + stats
features.note: Lazy-loaded route /stocks/:ticker. Bloomberg terminal style: confidence score with colored progress bar + 4 sub-scores grid, 90-day candlestick ChartPanel (lightweight-charts), institution holdings table (value/change/weight), insider trades timeline with ALL/BUY/SELL filter, localStorage watchlist toggle, footer status bar. 12.62KB chunk. DashboardPage ticker cells now navigate to stock detail.
